rules: Classify elected body type and jurisdiction from PKW/GUS evidence, never a calendar label.
Gmina councils and separate direct wójt/burmistrz/prezydent offices are municipal; cities with county rights have one city council.
Voivodeship sejmiks are regional. Powiat councils are proposed regional with a separate focused category review.
Warsaw district councils and the EP delegation are proposed other. National Sejm/Senat/President map national→national_context.
Historic Ostrowice offices remain municipal. No inferred merger successor, appointed voivode, PM/cabinet or auxiliary-office placeholder.
All tiers remain draft; missing/unknown never silently maps to other.

notes.reason: 55 older statistical territorial codes lack a projected elected-office identity in the acquired PKW2014/2018/2024 returns. Their exact GUS versions/names/years are retained in historic-territory-research-queue.json. Obtain pre-2014 electoral-body registers and legal identity bindings; do not fabricate direct executives before direct elections or merger successor edges.

Pre-1999 voivodeships/powiats and early post-1990 councils are not reconstructed. Retain current and evidenced Ostrowice historic bodies; older elected-body archives, institutional start/end dates and successor bindings remain open.

PKW published candidates/results and index dates do not establish a complete legal chronology. Certification, court rulings, annulments, repeats and unopposed/no-ballot status require source-specific review. No event is labelled certified by assumption.

Sejm/Senat2019 fields titled Procent contain fractional-looking values. Exact raw lexemes retained; typed share NULL/unknown, no automatic ×100. Verify workbook percentage formatting and source definitions before any accepted numeric projection.

853 PKW special/repeated index calls are retained as events with actual supplied dates and body IDs. Their candidate/protocol returns are not projected. Indexed schedule or data level does not prove result completeness. New Szczawa/Grabówka bodies have no normalized 2025 result rows in this pack.

18 explicitly elected Warsaw district councils are included as other. Other sołectwa/auxiliary units are excluded because no clean nationwide elected-body register was acquired. District executives are not assumed popularly elected.
314 powiat councils proposed regional as an intermediate supra-gmina layer. Justin must decide this category separately from the 16 voivodeship sejmiks. Do not report 330 as 330 voivodeships.

EP delegation is one office, proposed other. Candidate results2019/2024 keep constituency/list denominators; no invented national percentage vector, next polling day, replacement-member or 2020 seat-transition universe.

Office names preserve the exact PKW source-year body labels and current GUS municipality names/kinds separately. Town-status/name/boundary changes can alter formal titles; current title recertification and legal continuity beyond exact code matching remain named reviews. No geometry or automatic successor crosswalk.

Normalized Sejm/Senat2019/2023, President2020/2025 and EP2019/2024 only. Earlier national cycles and Senate by-election returns require additional source work. Cancelled May2020 presidential schedule is not inserted as a held election.

No competition/tightness/margin calculation and no global party harmonization. Exact election-specific committee labels/signatures survive. Blank mandate indicators remain unknown; zero is stored only when explicitly supplied.

Local term2024–2029 supports expected year2029 metadata, not an invented day or new event. Other next ordinary dates remain NULL unless independently sourced. Upcoming-window filtering never deletes current/historic offices.
